title: Islamic ornaments
intro: Living reference for the ornament identity: the eight-pointed star (khatam) and the girih tile, in gold on deep emerald and in emerald and gold on light paper. Ornament is decorative only and never carries meaning or interaction. Try the ornament levels and switch language to see both directions.
